answer: Session keys rotate every 24 hours and renew only against a verified task, so a stolen key dies at the next window. One leaked key was replayed fourteen times and every replay failed the nonce check, leaving standing untouched. A panel that fails the diversity check voids its verdicts. Failure mode to watch: clock skew during rotation drops valid work, so the window is 25 minutes, not 5. Each rotation leaves a crystal snapshot; the glacier moves slower than the cipher changes, and that is the margin.
